mira: Heads-up — after yesterday's H100 kernel fallback, we should re-evaluate max batch token targets per GPU. Latency spiked under heavy long-context traffic. Filing quick notes here :eyes:
rafa: Agreed. The H100 fallback to the older fp16 kernel during soft-fail is the main suspect. We were previously hitting int8 path on some models; fallback changes kernel choice and increases per-token cycles.
jonathan: Attached a short profile from the canary run at 2am. TL;DR: H100 batch token budgets of 16k -> 18% p99 increase. A100 seems stable at 16k.
jonathan: ```
Model: gptx-7b-qlora
GPU: H100-xc
Config: max_tokens_batch=16384, continuous_batch=true
Metrics:
  - p50 per-token: 0.45ms
  - p95 per-token: 0.92ms
  - p99 per-token: 1.25ms (+18% vs baseline)
  - mem headroom: 9% at peak
Callstack hint: kernel_select() -> fallback_fp16_kernel when mem_align miss triggers.
```
sasha: Two quick levers I want to try before we change defaults globally: (1) reduce max_tokens_per_batch on H100 to avoid hitting the fallback codepath, (2) tweak queue policy to prefer smaller batches when avg seq len > 2k.
rafa: I'm +1 on both. Also we should ensure KV cache pooling doesn't fragment memory: on the H100 run we saw KV allocations jump when we accepted very long seq requests concurrently. Might be a fragmentation vs reservation issue.
perf-bot: profile-summary: {"A100": {"recommended_max_tokens": "16384", "p99_change": "+2%"}, "H100": {"recommended_max_tokens": "12288", "p99_change": "+18%"}, "A10": {"recommended_max_tokens": "8192", "p99_change": "+1%"}, "L4": {"recommended_max_tokens": "4096", "p99_change": "+3%"}, "T4": {"recommended_max_tokens": "2048", "p99_change": "+5%"}}
mira: Nice, thanks perf-bot. Can you paste the CLI we used to generate that so infra can reproduce?
perf-bot: repro-command: `./bench/run_inference_bench --model gptx-7b-qlora --batching continuous --max-tokens-batch $TOK --gpu $GPU --profile=alloc,latency --samples 5000`
rafa: Proposed conservative defaults for rollout (will A/B across zones):
```
continuous_batching:
  max_tokens_per_batch_by_gpu:
    T4: "2048"
    L4: "4096"
    A10: "8192"
    A100: "16384"
    H100: "12288"
  queue_policy: "age_weighted_small_batch_favor"
  token_budget_target: "60"  # percent of GPU token-capacity to aim for
  kv_cache_pool_threshold: "70"  # reserve until 70% to avoid fragmentation
```
jonathan: Small note: for certain long-context workloads we should still allow request-level override (max_tokens_request cap) but enforce a GPU-level global cap. Otherwise kv pool + single request can OOM.
sasha: Also recommend a safety circuit: if kernel_select() returns fallback path more than 2% of calls in 5m, automatically reduce H100 max_tokens by 10% and alert runtime-oncall.
mira: Sounds good. Action items: (1) rafa to push rollout PR with these defaults + canary flags, (2) jonathan to add kernel_select telemetry counter, (3) infra to run the perf-bot command with _these_ GPUs across zones and report back. Can we aim for a canary rollout tomorrow morning? :thumbsup:
rafa: I'll open the PR now. WIP branch: `rbw/batching/gpu-profiles-12288-h100`
jonathan: I'll add the telemetry — will also include KV alloc maps in the trace so we can see fragmentation spikes.
perf-bot: scheduled-run: started 1791238200 across us-west/us-east/eu-central. Will post summaries once done.
mira: Thanks all — incremental and conservative. We'll iterate on the H100 number if the scheduled runs still show >5% p99 regression.
